Season well.Toast the brioche slices and serve alongside.Gekko's oysters on iceFresh oysters on crushed ice, red wine vinegar and shallot dressing, lemonHow to make it24 oysters, freshly shucked1 bag crushed ice80ml red wine vinegar1 shallot1 lemoncracked black pepper, to tasteShuck the oysters (or ask the fishmonger to) and lay them on crushed ice.Mix the vinegar with the finely diced shallot and cracked pepper.Cut the lemon into wedges and serve with the dressing on the side.Sushi platterSeasoned rice in salmon and tuna nigiri and cucumber rolls, for Bud's new sushi makerHow to make itNot on tonight's cookSushi rice seasoned with rice vinegar, sugar and salt, shaped into salmon and tuna nigiri, plus cucumber maki, with wasabi and pickled ginger.Parker House rolls with cultured butterGreed is good. Bring to room temperature 30 minutes before cooking.Sear the steaks hard in the neutral oil in a very hot pan on both sides.Add the butter and rosemary and baste the steaks. Rest on a plate for 8 minutes.In the same pan, crush in the peppercorns, add the brandy and flame it carefully.Add the stock and cream and reduce until the sauce coats a spoon.Pour the sauce over the rested steaks.Carl's cheeseburgerThick chuck patty griddled medium, melted cheddar, lettuce, tomato and pickles on a toasted bunHow to make itNot on tonight's cookThick chuck patty seasoned at the last moment, griddled to medium, cheddar melted on top, lettuce, tomato and pickles on a toasted bun.On the board tonightGekko's birthday cheesecakeLemon cheesecake.
